spans.s:
नेम नेम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. नम् with ए
instead of reduplication, but said to be fr. rt. 1. नी;
नेम is one of the सर्वादि or pronominals accord-
ing to Pāṇ.

, but the nom. pl. m. is either
नेमे or नेमास्), Ved. some, a few, several, (accord-
ing to Sāy. नेम = अल्प, कतिपय; नेमे = के-
चने, also = एते, these); the one, the other; half;
(अस्), m. a part, portion; time, period, season; term,
boundary, limit; a fence, enclosure, a boundary wall
or hedge; the foundation of a wall; a hole, a chasm;
fraud, deceit; acting, dancing; evening; a root; food
(Ved.); upper part, above; (अम्), n. a particular
number; [cf. Zend naima.]
—नेम-चन्द्र, अस्,
m. ‘the half moon,’ N. of a prince of Bengal.
—ने-
म-धित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. divided, set at variance;
(आस्), m. pl., scil. सङ्ग्रामाः, battles in which only
some are engaged; (अस्), m., scil. इन्द्रः, the sharer of
half the oblation, the other half going to all the gods;
(see Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

.)
—नेम-धिति, इस्,
[]
f., Ved. battle, conflict, dispute.
—नेम-नाथ, अस्,
m., N. of a man who is also called Nitya-nātha.
—नेम-साह, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—नेमादित्य
(˚म-आद्˚), अस्, m., N. of a man, father of Trivi-
krama-bhaṭṭa, the author of the Damayantī-kathā.

नेमि, इस्, ई, f. the circumference or ring or felly or
outer rim of a wheel; edge, rim; a windlass or frame-
work for the rope of a well; a thunderbolt, a circle or
circumference in general, the earth; (इस्), m. the
plant Dalbergia Ougeinensis; N. of a Daitya; (with
Jainas) N. of the twenty-second Arhat of the present
Ut-sarpiṇī; N. of a Cakra-vartin; a sacred place, as
Mathurā (?).
—नेमि-चक्र, अस्, m. a prince de-
scended from Parīkṣit, who is said to have removed
the capital of India to Kauśāmbi after the inunda-
tion of Hāstina-pura.
—नेमिन्-धर, अस्, m., N.
of a mountain.

नेमन्निष् नेमन्न्-इष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. (perhaps)
following guidance?; (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda
1. 56, 2), moving reverentially or bearing oblations.
